title: License record by holder
summary: The license record's header, holder card and origin card for the two holder states licenses.detail doesn't draw: Waiting (Tomás Okafor, made by hand, invitation sent) and Floating (a key from the Controller bundle batch), covering the By hand and Key batch origins.
compare: Waiting: h1 is the person's name with 'Waiting for sign-in' as info-tone status text; the holder line is the Waiting pill, the email, the license id chip (ID icon, copy) and 'Invitation sent <date>'. Resend invitation is the primary; Change email… is on the holder card and in the ⋯ menu; Devices is empty and says why.

Floating: h1 is the masked key in mono; the holder line is the Floating pill, 'Anyone with the key' and the id chip; there is no email anywhere. Assign to a person is the primary. The holder card says only a hash of the key is kept, so the key can't be shown or copied (copy is on the license id), and that adding the key to a library moves the license into that account.
By hand origin card: 'Created by hand by <member>, <date>' with the reason, the note that Access rules never change a license made by hand, and Open Activity.
Key batch origin card: the batch label, how many keys, the tier, who made it and when, how many are used, the Disable unused keys hint, and Open batch.
Every holder state keeps the tier control (Tier <name> ▾) top-right and the same five tabs as licenses.detail.
Phone: the state's primary goes full width first, then the tier control and ⋯; the tab counts hide so the five tabs fit.
